summary: Iter127 frontend-only sweep of v3.24 Collab + Multi-party UI affordances. 8/10 items VERIFIED PASS via live UI on http://localhost:3000 with admin@test.com. Items 6 & 7 VERIFIED-BY-CODE-REVIEW (gating conditions correct, components imported & rendered conditionally) but live UI navigation was blocked by environmental factors (admin user has 0 SMART goals; SF progress dots are icons not labeled with numbers — could not click to step 5 via text selector in 3 attempts). NOTE: A stale Metro bundle cache was serving the OLD 3-CTA Conflict Breaker landing on the first visit; restarting expo (`sudo supervisorctl restart expo`) resolved it. After restart, all CB UI matched the new single 'Start a Crucial Conversation' code.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID attributes on 'Share this step' / 'Schedule call' buttons in CollabBar.tsx; modals also lack testID. Slows down automated testing. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CollabBar.tsx:37,43; StepShareModal.tsx; AppointmentSchedulerModal.tsx.

Step icons in the progress bar render as Ionicons only — no numeric label and no testID. There is no easy way to programmatically (or for a user) jump directly to step 5; only Next/Back. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx (progressRow component).

action_items: 1. Add testID attributes to CollabBar share/schedule pill buttons + the two modals' Send/Schedule/Close buttons (e.g. testID="collab-share-step-btn", "collab-schedule-call-btn", "share-modal-send", "share-modal-close", "appt-modal-schedule", "appt-modal-close") to make iter128+ UI automation faster and more robust. Currently we rely on visible text which is fragile.
2. (Optional UX) Number the Solution Finder progress dots (1–6) like Conflict Breaker does (1–9) so users can jump steps and so testing can locate them via text.

3. E1 self-test items 6 (Goal Setter create→save→verify CollabBar+DCP appear) and 7 (Solution Finder advance via Next to Q5 Action Plan and confirm CollabBar+DCP) — code paths verified, but a live screenshot would be definitive.

4. Investigate why the first browser session loaded a STALE Conflict Breaker bundle (showed old 3-CTA Prepare/Repair/Reflect tiles). Restarting expo cleared it. May indicate Metro cache invalidation issue when source switched from 3 CTAs to 1 CTA — could affect users on slow networks.
critical_code_review_comments: CollabBar.tsx (70 lines) and StepShareModal/AppointmentSchedulerModal contain NO testID props — all selectors must use visible text, which is fragile and i18n-unfriendly. Add testIDs.

PartiesManager (inlined in conflict-breaker.tsx ~line 1077) — long-press to rename is a touch-only gesture; on web there's no equivalent affordance shown in the chip UI. Consider adding a small ✎ pencil icon on hover/tap for web users.

DecisionContinuePanel: 8 cards in a horizontal ScrollView — on a 414px-wide mobile viewport only ~2.5 cards are visible at once; cards farther right require horizontal scroll. Confirmed all 8 are present in DOM via JS evaluation, but the user may not realise more exist. Consider adding a chevron/affordance hint or wrapping to 2 rows.

_public_link in collab_routes.py still defaults to https://jelcos.ai (carried over from iter126) — invites generated in preview will email a link to PROD, not preview. Set PUBLIC_APP_URL env var in /app/backend/.env for accurate preview-link generation.
